page.overview:
Who is Damdo?

Damdo, known as in Japan, is a character from the Street Fighter II V series.

He fought in Kowloon Walled City's underground street fights as a champion. When the owner of the underworld fights is angered by Ryu and Ken Masters' presence. He was ordered to fight against Ryu and lost. His fighting moves resembles kind of Chinese martial arts, probably Chinese Kempo. He shares the same Japanese name as Thrasher Damnd prior to Street Fighter 6.

It is with his defeat that his superior Lin orders a hit on Ryu, Ken and Chun-Li for disgracing his reputation. Category:Characters Category:Street Fighter II V Characters Category:Male Characters Category:Non Video Game Characters Category:Characters born in China Category:Characters born in Asia
